name: discover_novel_5split_mirror
description: RL discovery with the 2+3 mass lattice excluded (novelty run): a 5-split cycle that comes back MIRRORED (A and B swap roles) -> 10 splits per full cycle. Repeats 28/37 half-cycles (longest run 18), median layout error 22.9 units, 20 ticks per half-cycle; 17.2 rotations, drift 168 units. Pieces are multiples of 1,321 (1/28 of the total). Early and not yet stable.
